node.title: Re: using "require" problem
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
For paths that are always relative to the script's location, the core module [doc://FindBin] works well:

use FindBin; require "$FindBin::Bin/routines.pl";

Update: [hippo] [id://1200091|makes a good point] that [doc://require] will search [doc://@INC], so yet another way to make it work is with [doc://lib], as I showed [id://1200092|here], and below. But I also agree with [Discipulus]' [id://1200090|point] that turning the file into a separate package might be a good idea too. use FindBin; use lib $FindBin::Bin; require "routines.pl";
